integrity: All numerical statements derive from a written intersection-theoretic argument and exact integer polynomial identities; a standalone checker is provided for corroboration. Source contributions and unresolved literature risks are identified, with no claim of independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only general pencils and three-dimensional isotropic subspaces are treated; the nontrivial theorem covers all positive-dimensional cases n at least three, with the n=2 point boundary noted.
No complete ring presentation, rational-coefficient nonisomorphism theorem, or extension to other subspace ranks is claimed.
An in-preparation manuscript on S2Gr(3,7) listed in the originating paper was not available for a material-content comparison; an unindexed equivalent degree computation remains possible.
title: Integral ring nonisomorphism for every positive-dimensional odd biisotropic three-plane Grassmannian
